_comment: NOTE: do not add a `回复 ok` instruction here. This post is read in DEV_TRIAGE, where `ok` is not a dev_reply (reply_parser excludes DEV_TRIAGE) and, for an operator who is also on the approver namelist, resolves to APPROVE via _APPROVER_OK_STATES — i.e. the instruction could approve the MR. The `ok` prompt lives on revision_request, which is read in *_REVISION. Round 2+ incremental review — no MR link. Shows issue status (fixed/unfixed). Self-service loop (DESIGN §1.23.6): addressed to the DEVELOPER, not the approver — the dev triages what is left, keeps iterating, and hands off with `done` when satisfied. The approver is only @-mentioned by handoff_summary.

content.text: 请确认本轮仍需修复的问题:
· 回复问题序号（如 1 3 5）确认修复这些问题，其余视为有异议
· 回复 "-2" 表示仅对 #2 有异议，其余修复；回复 "all" 全部修复
· 序号后可附异议理由（如 "-2 该写法是有意为之"），提交终审时一并转交审查人
· 回复 "done" 提交审查人终审
